question: Which is a commonly used antimicrobial preservative in food and beverages, especially carbonated beverages, as it presents its strongest antibacterial activity at pH 2.5 – 4.0?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Benzoic acid.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Benzoic acid** is a commonly used antimicrobial preservative in food and beverages, especially carbonated beverages, as it presents its strongest antibacterial activity at pH 2.5 – 4.0.

 
• Benzoic Acid is extensively used for food preservation.
 
• Its formula is C6H5COOH.
 
• Because of its antimicrobial preservative action, it is most suitable for foods, fruit juices, and soft drinks that are naturally in an acidic pH range.
 
• It is also used in the form of sodium salt called sodium benzoate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Acrylic is a synthetic fiber.

 
 
• Acrylic is commonly known as synthetic wool because it mimics wool.
 
• Acrylic is used to make sweaters, blankets, and a variety of other garments.
 
• They are also used to fill soft toys and pillows, in addition to producing garments.
 
 
 
• The IUPAC name of CH₃CH₂COOH is propanoic acid. 
 
 
• This compound contains 3 carbon atoms, so its parent alkane is propane. 
 
• The name of this compound can be obtained by replacing the last 'e' of propane with 'oic acid' which gives us propanoic acid.
